body:
The "Synced X min ago" line only recomputes on a sync-state change, so it can
read "just now" indefinitely. Android: recompose SyncStatusBar's nowMs about
once a minute (e.g. produceState + delay loop). Web: a 60s interval tick in
SyncIndicator. Keep the pure formatters as-is.
title: Sync recency label should tick, not freeze on 'just now' (both clients)
